identity.label: Claude CLI
identity.description: The local claude binary running as an unattended subprocess. Full agentic harness - the CLI owns tool execution and its own permission sandbox - which is why it is the only syndicate that can serve filesystem missions.

channels.label: CLI Default Model
channels.notes: Model selection is delegated to the operator's claude CLI configuration; the agency does not pin it. Sustained autonomous cycles here are the expensive path - route text-only work to an amortized syndicate.
